facts.fact: Makerere University's MakSPH-METS programme handed over 16 fully developed digital health systems to the Ministry of Health on 31 March 2026, among them OpenHIM, named as the platform for health information exchange, alongside UgandaEMR repositories, eIDSR and the Weekly Stock Status System.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health (handed over by Makerere University MakSPH-METS)

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's HIE and Interoperability Guidelines (January 2023) say ad-hoc exchanges exist, with EMRs exchanging data with the national Viral Load Information System and the mTrac surveillance system exchanging data with the national eHMIS, none premised on nationally endorsed guidelines.
facts.system: Viral Load Information System; mTrac; eHMIS

note: The text is an excerpt; the guidelines set standards for an OpenHIE-style HIE but the captured part states no national HIE in service. As_of is the published date, January 2023.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health launched the National Laboratory Data Repository, which New Vision reports links all laboratory information systems across the country to the National Health Data Warehouse and consolidates facility laboratory data into one national repository with real-time access for authorised users (no launch date given; the story's published date is used).

note: Only a general remark of active exchange initiatives; no system, build or service stated.
